nodes.label: Intel Media Driver Build Script
nodes.rationale: Builds gmmlib 22.7.2 and intel-media-driver 25.2.6 from source into /rootfs because Debian's packaged driver lacks Battlemage (Xe2) support. Uses Intel's jammy repo for libva-dev 2.22, which supplies the VVC decode headers media-driver 25.x needs. On non-x86_64 it creates an empty /rootfs so the downstream Dockerfile COPY --from still has a valid source.

edges.source_location: make install DESTDIR=/rootfs and the empty-/rootfs non-x86_64 guard
